## About Emma

Emma Rodriguez is Managing Director of RetailFlow, joining 5 years ago from Myer where she was Operations Director. The board brought her in specifically to modernise RetailFlow and drive digital transformation.

Emma is under pressure to deliver results on the transformation agenda while navigating the competing priorities of growth, profitability, and organisational readiness.

## Strategic Focus

- Digital transformation and AI adoption
- Competitive positioning against online retailers
- Board expectations and investor relations
- Balancing speed with bringing people along
